title: Repository stewardship references
scope: Three official resources with concrete uses, limitations and dated checks; deliberately not an exhaustive best-of list.

entries.title: GitHub community profiles
entries.why: Shows how repository health files become visible to contributors.
entries.use_when: You need to make licensing, contribution rules and conduct guidance discoverable.
entries.limitation: Checklist completeness does not prove moderation capacity or repository quality.

entries.title: Open Source Guides: maintainer practices
entries.why: Offers practical reasons to automate regressions and document contribution workflows.
entries.use_when: You are reducing repeated review work and explaining how contributors run tests.
entries.limitation: Examples are guidance, not a replacement for project-specific risk assessment.

entries.title: Awesome list manifesto
entries.why: Argues for selective inclusion, informative descriptions and transparent contribution criteria.
entries.use_when: You are deciding whether a resource belongs in a small expert-curated collection.
entries.limitation: Its badge and submission rules belong to that project; following them does not confer endorsement.
